scope: Local implementation and isolated verification of bounded image libraries, thumbnails and BroccoliDB admission. Existing uncommitted navigation work is preserved; no commit, push, migration deployment, paid generation or production mutation.

findings.finding: Unbounded recent results and accumulated library pages
findings.resolution: 120-entry recent working set with string budget and selected/newest preservation; one 36-image saved page; explicit Previous/Next and empty-page recovery.

findings.finding: Full-library summary work repeated for every page and timestamp precision loss
findings.resolution: Additive page-only RPC, matching partial indexes, bound parameters, microsecond-preserving timestamp/ID cursors and both directions.

findings.finding: Partial hot history used as complete outage fallback; older-asset lookup limited by warming
findings.resolution: Configured database reads fail explicitly; single owner/ID lookup is authoritative even on warm artifact hits.

findings.finding: Unbounded cache/write metadata and repeated identical reads
findings.resolution: BroccoliDB LRU count/byte/TTL caps, bounded unique work and queue waits, shared in-flight reads; unsaved entries never evicted.

findings.finding: Full originals in every thumbnail and unbounded storage-read lifetime/bytes
findings.resolution: 512-pixel reencoded WebP previews, bounded transformation work and cache; streamed byte limits, aborts and bounded gzip expansion.

findings.finding: Thumbnail child missing from public-product route policy, caught by compiled review
findings.resolution: Exact child exemption, no arbitrary descendants; capability and authoritative ownership remain required. Policy unit test and compiled invalid-capability 404 confirm the integration.

findings.finding: Full prompts eagerly transferred; detail races and failed-page continuity
findings.resolution: 300-character card preview, lazy full details/reuse, disabled copy/reuse until loaded, cancelled stale detail responses, exact failed-page retry.

findings.finding: Mobile grid density and extra refresh row
findings.resolution: Uniform contained thumbnails, two phone columns, accessible icon reuse, compact heading/refresh row, top and bottom page controls.

limits: No production database migration, deployment, paid generation, live load, remote CI or account mutation.
Local SQL medians are five-run loopback fixtures; no production latency/SLO or overall site-capacity guarantee.
Caches/queues are per process; unique-work coalescing does not limit every HTTP caller and byte budgets exclude JavaScript/index/decoder overhead.
Selected/newest legacy inline images can exceed the normal recent string budget; the newest results remain reachable.
Rare substring searches can inspect many owner rows. Legacy summary/session APIs are not all converted to the new compact paging contract.
A cold thumbnail still reads/decodes the original. Multi-instance cold traffic and on-demand processing costs require production observation.
Application/storage writes are not one atomic commit; failed metadata admission may leave an uploaded artifact for private reconciliation.
No physical-device, full screen-reader or measured Core Web Vitals acceptance. Final UI review was local Chrome with synthetic results.
The additive function/index migration must precede the application; writer-blocking index creation needs target-specific rollout review.
